scope: 13 benchmark product families: 4 Taiwan, 4 international consumer portals, 5 professional valuation/data providers

status_definitions.VERIFIED_CURRENT: First-party public documentation describes a currently supplied or shipped capability, including restricted beta where explicitly stated. Documentation verified; feature behavior, accuracy, entitlement and production reliability were not independently UI tested.
status_definitions.ANNOUNCED: First-party source describes future rollout or planned availability; not counted as generally shipped.
status_definitions.INFERRED: Analyst inference from named evidence; never treated as documented functionality.
status_definitions.UNVERIFIED: Relevant first-party claim exists but retrieval, currentness or scope cannot support verification.
status_definitions.UNKNOWN: No sufficiently specific claim established by this bounded review; means unknown, not absent.

retrieval_levels.OPENED_PRIMARY: Official page opened and relevant readable content retrieved.
retrieval_levels.OPENED_PRIMARY_PARTIAL: Official page opened but extraction omitted, failed intermittently, or returned only partial shell; limitation recorded.
retrieval_levels.SEARCH_SNIPPET_PRIMARY: First-party indexed snippet only; direct page blocked or content unavailable.

methodology.absence_policy: All capability cells initialized UNKNOWN. No absence inferred from missing marketing or inaccessible login areas.
methodology.copyright_policy: Concise original paraphrases only; no copied article passages.
methodology.date_policy: Exclude publication dates later than 2026-10-10. Undated live pages record publication_date=null and date_precision=not_stated; date_checked does not imply recent product launch.
methodology.product_family_policy: Related subproducts included only where claim explicitly names its scope; vendor-wide functionality must not be attributed to every subproduct.

interpretation_notes.reason: Assigned scope says garbled user name likely this; interpretation retained explicitly, not silently corrected.

sources.title: 591 房屋交易網首頁
sources.paraphrase: Lists buy/rent/map/community/transaction-price services, favorites and browsing-history panels, price-alert app promotion, mortgage and affordability tools, and rental contract downloads.
sources.evidence_limitations: AI self-service controls concern account/listing support; they do not establish conversational home search. Contract links are templates, not a document vault.

sources.title: 591 官方關於我們
sources.paraphrase: Identifies 數字科技股份有限公司 as operator and 591 as a company platform.
sources.evidence_limitations: Older company-history content retained only for identity; no financial figures reused.

sources.title: 房貸計算器－2026版
sources.paraphrase: Offers mortgage repayment calculation on an official live tool page.
sources.evidence_limitations: Calculation was not submitted; no current bank rate or loan approval claim.

sources.title: 樂居首頁
sources.publisher: 樂居科技股份有限公司
sources.paraphrase: Navigation exposes map/list transaction-price search, property/community search, membership and observation lists.
sources.evidence_limitations: 看屋筆記 navigation is editorial content, not proof of user-created notes. Seller/report navigation does not establish a completed report export.

sources.title: 常見問答：網站功能
sources.paraphrase: Explains adding/removing community watchlist entries and following recent transaction markets.
sources.evidence_limitations: FAQ's future strengthening promises do not establish alerts or a side-by-side comparison UI.

sources.title: 抽屜模式全新上線！一眼就看懂社區房價
sources.paraphrase: Documents a visual drawer display of full community transaction details.
sources.evidence_limitations: Historical launch article, still publicly accessible; not a current UI test and not a property AVM.

sources.title: 信義房屋實價登錄
sources.paraphrase: Shows listing/transaction subscriptions, government versus Sinyi sale provenance, repeat-transfer estimates, special-transaction exclusion notes, MRT/location search and mortgage links.
sources.evidence_limitations: Transfer counts are estimated; disclosure lag and incomplete monthly data explicitly acknowledged. MRT proximity does not establish commute-time analysis.

sources.title: 懂你的 AI 房仲，伴你安心成家
sources.paraphrase: 義起聊 combines AI recommendations, a human agent, LINE push notifications and viewing reminders; AI decluttering and lifestyle-area search have instructions and experience links.
sources.evidence_limitations: AI plus human chat is narrower than an autonomous financial/legal assistant. DiNDON virtual viewing is not scheduling evidence by itself.

sources.title: 永慶 AI 特助
sources.paraphrase: AI找房 covers properties, communities and markets; LINE i特助 pushes new cases, tracks communities, computes mortgages, arranges viewings and invites family; AI declutter/staging/tour features are described.
sources.evidence_limitations: i特助, AI清空, AI煥裝 and AI導覽 explicitly limited to Taipei/New Taipei direct-operated area; do not extrapolate to all franchises.

sources.title: 追蹤社區、降價通知：會員功能
sources.paraphrase: Members save followed properties and communities, write property remarks, receive community new-listing notices and arrange/remind viewings.
sources.evidence_limitations: Historical article retained with live membership navigation; a remarks field is not a structured inspection checklist.

sources.title: AI 找房：對話時代
sources.paraphrase: Describes released natural-language property/community search and querying government registered plus YungChing recent sales prices.
sources.evidence_limitations: Provider claim about retrieval; answer accuracy and source attribution per generated answer not tested.

sources.title: Advanced search guide
sources.paraphrase: Documents saved searches, notification cadence, saved-home changes, partner tags/shares and side-by-side saved-home comparison.
sources.evidence_limitations: Co-shopping tags/shared notifications are not evidence of transaction document collaboration.

sources.title: What is a Zestimate?
sources.paraphrase: Explains public/MLS/user inputs, neural model, prior sales/market signals, estimated sale range and regional accuracy statistics.
sources.evidence_limitations: AVM is not an appraisal; provider accuracy metrics are not independently validated or comparable across providers.

sources.title: What Is BuyAbility?
sources.paraphrase: BuyAbility retains buyer inputs and uses current personalized mortgage rates to update purchase budget and monthly payment, labeling eligible listings.
sources.evidence_limitations: Estimate is distinct from prequalification/preapproval; no acquisition-cost completeness claim.

sources.title: Zillow debuts AI mode
sources.paraphrase: Describes AI mode shipped in beta to a limited user group, with expansion planned through 2026.
sources.evidence_limitations: Do not treat expansion as generally available. Public product behavior was not exercised.

sources.title: How Zillow’s new AI mode works
sources.paraphrase: Explains routing conversational questions to property, financing and valuation tools; maintains conversational/activity context.
sources.evidence_limitations: Architecture description does not prove every action succeeds or establish a user-visible browsing-history page.

sources.title: Example listing: First Street referral
sources.paraphrase: Opened sample listing provides dated sale/listing/price-change and public tax history; indexed primary text separately mentions external First Street referral.
sources.evidence_limitations: Direct extraction did not reliably include the risk section; native risk scores remain UNKNOWN. Old 2024 launch materials not used to prove current availability.

sources.title: RealAssist AI launch
sources.paraphrase: Launch release describes natural-language search, affordability, side-by-side comparisons, commute/routine maps, visualization and tour connections; select logged-in users had beta access.
sources.evidence_limitations: Broad availability was planned. Sophisticated example prompts are product claims, not independently verified answer accuracy or calculation completeness.

sources.title: Realtor.com+ Fall Release 2026
sources.paraphrase: Published release page describes agent/client/co-buyer shared workspace, persistent listing notes, notification digest and RPR-linked reports.
sources.evidence_limitations: Realtor.com+ eligibility/participating MLS scope; full RPR reports require appropriate REALTOR access. Exact release day not stated.

sources.title: Quarterly product update July 2026
sources.paraphrase: Indexed official update says Realtor.com+ lets agents/clients search, share, chat and plan tours; mentions relaunch of My Home.
sources.evidence_limitations: Direct open redirected to Europe-region availability block. Main claims rely on other opened official sources; this is supplemental.

sources.title: Favorites & Favorite Lists
sources.paraphrase: Documents custom favorite lists stored in account and listing/open-house alert subscriptions.
sources.evidence_limitations: Website/iOS documented; Android list rollout described as later in year and not assumed complete. Download/map favorites described as future.

sources.title: Shared Saved Searches
sources.paraphrase: Explains inviting a registered search partner, sharing saved searches and seeing prior/future property comments.
sources.evidence_limitations: Comments are general listing remarks, not a formal viewing checklist.

sources.title: Conversational Search guide
sources.paraphrase: Provides web/iOS/Android conversational-search entry instructions and examples constrained by commute time; identifies Redfin Estimate and Buying Power as existing products.
sources.evidence_limitations: AVM mention is high-level; uncertainty/per-property explanation not established by this source.

sources.title: Air quality risk data for U.S. homes
sources.paraphrase: Documents property climate tab containing First Street air-quality, wildfire, flood, heat and wind risks.
sources.evidence_limitations: Historical launch document remains published; current risk coverage/extraction not independently sampled. Android timing originally prospective.

sources.title: Homes.com Real Estate App
sources.paraphrase: Describes map layers, full inventory search, push new-listing/price/open-house updates and co-shopper favorites comparison, notes and messages; finance tools in navigation.
sources.evidence_limitations: 3D tours not equated with viewing scheduling; generic home-value map layer not a confidence metric.

sources.title: How do I save my search?
sources.paraphrase: Instructions cover saving location/filters and editing/deleting saved searches through profile.
sources.evidence_limitations: Does not independently prove cross-device sync correctness.

sources.title: Example live property: 8808 Quadro Court
sources.paraphrase: Page exposes four named AVM providers, value/report controls, tax/sales/deed/mortgage histories and open-house calendar links.
sources.evidence_limitations: Opened page returned current-month AVMs Not Available although indexed snippet had values. Multi-provider value range is model disagreement, not a calibrated confidence interval. Report button not executed.

sources.title: Property Explorer
sources.paraphrase: Interactive valuation workbench selects comps, compares AVM/after-repair values, condition scenarios, generates value reports and shares editable links/API reports.
sources.evidence_limitations: Single-family focus; vendor accuracy/speed/superiority statements not accepted as independently established.

sources.title: Data Explorer / API
sources.paraphrase: Named endpoints cover AVM confidence/data density/next steps, sales/tax/liens, rental reports, FEMA flood/disaster and earthquake/weather risk.
sources.evidence_limitations: Premium endpoints may cost extra. Professional risk data separate from Property Explorer UI availability.

sources.title: Property Explorer Quick Start Guide
sources.paraphrase: Documents similarity-based comp selection, adjustments, instant comparable value recalculation and selecting a final report value.
sources.evidence_limitations: Professional adjustment evidence; not a consumer affordability calculator or full model feature attribution.

sources.title: UK automated valuation models
sources.paraphrase: Describes sale/rent comps, confidence/range outputs, licensed multi-source data, traceable provenance and real-time API/report valuation.
sources.evidence_limitations: This source establishes UK scope; marketing statements about regulatory alignment not treated as regulatory approval.

sources.title: Property Advisor dossier overview
sources.paraphrase: Explains estimated price/range, high/medium/low confidence reasons, manual recommendation override and PDF/Property Page/permalink output.
sources.evidence_limitations: Shared report/page is weaker than concurrent case editing. Article uses automated translation.

sources.title: UK property valuation software
sources.paraphrase: Documents branded PDF/online property reports, market analysis and spreadsheet portfolio valuation/API integration.
sources.evidence_limitations: UK-specific product family; no consumer closing-cost or commute tool claim.

sources.title: Total Home Value X
sources.paraphrase: THVx offers U.S. property valuation tunings, confidence/FSD, last market sale, nearby listings, HPI trends and API/file/cloud deliveries.
sources.evidence_limitations: Nearby listings not sufficient to claim adjustable comparable grids. Underwriting use case not a consumer finance tool. No causal explainability claim.

sources.title: CoreLogic rebrands to Cotality
sources.paraphrase: First-party release establishes CoreLogic to Cotality brand transition and global business context.
sources.evidence_limitations: Used for identity only; global company operations do not imply THVx availability in Taiwan.

sources.title: Quantarium Valuation Models
sources.paraphrase: Offers AI/computer-vision residential U.S. property valuations and collateral/geographic use cases.
sources.evidence_limitations: Vendor number-one/Fitch-related superiority claims not independently verified and omitted from benchmark score.

sources.title: Reports Marketplace
sources.paraphrase: Named report tiers include value range/confidence, comparable sales/listings/maps, transaction/price/listing histories and QCMA automated adjustments; ProxyPics condition plus AVM report available.
sources.evidence_limitations: Features vary by report tier. Ordering, report output and confidence calibration not tested.

sources.title: ATTOM AVM
sources.paraphrase: Residential AVM combines validated county/MLS data, local time normalization and blended ML; outputs ranges/confidence through API/bulk.
sources.evidence_limitations: Single-family/condo/townhouse scope. Explainability is documented methodology, not per-property causal drivers.

sources.title: ATTOM Cloud AVM dataset help
sources.paraphrase: Defines valuation date, min/max, FSD and score calculation with uncertainty interpretation and permanent property ID.
sources.evidence_limitations: Provider documentation; no independent calibration validation. Numerical performance claims differ from marketing guide, so no cross-vendor accuracy ranking.

sources.title: A Quick Guide to Real Estate AVMs
sources.paraphrase: Details cleaning non-arm-length sales, hyperlocal index adjustments and blended ML valuation; documents rental AVM scope.
sources.evidence_limitations: Accuracy figures differ from Cloud help; sample/period not reconciled. No accuracy leadership assertion.

sources.title: Notification Settings
sources.paraphrase: Controls saved-search/favorite alerts and frequency, agent-tour text reminders, and home/market report subscriptions.
sources.evidence_limitations: Older help article; alert delivery not independently tested.

findings.title: Consumer continuity
findings.finding: Saved homes/communities and listing/price alerts recur in consumer competitors. Leju community watchlist established; automated alert availability UNKNOWN.

findings.title: Notes and collaboration
findings.finding: 永慶 records property remarks; Redfin partners see previous/future comments; Homes.com co-shoppers share notes/messages; Realtor.com+ has persistent group notes. Editorial 看屋筆記 is not a user notes feature.

findings.title: Valuation evidence and uncertainty
findings.finding: All five professional providers publish ranges/confidence. HouseCanary adjustable comp evidence and PriceHubble confidence/manual-override help are stronger evidence workflows than a point estimate alone.

findings.title: Conversational search with restricted access
findings.finding: Taiwan brokers and Redfin document usable search/conversation surfaces. Zillow AI mode and June Realtor consumer launch are limited beta; general expansion remains separately ANNOUNCED.

findings.title: Climate data currentness
findings.finding: Redfin historical shipped climate-tab docs and HouseCanary risk endpoints exist. Zillow old native-score launch cannot prove current native score availability; indexed external-link snippet remained unverified in opened listing.

findings.title: No unsupported accuracy ranking
findings.finding: Different self-reported vendor metrics have incompatible samples/timeframes. ATTOM Cloud help versus June 2026 guide numbers differ; no most-accurate winner or Taiwan transfer accuracy asserted.

findings.title: Entitlements and geography
findings.finding: 雙北 direct-operated AI/LINE, participating MLS collaboration, UK regional products, U.S. residential AVMs and premium endpoints have distinct availability. No Taiwan coverage or redistribution license inferred.

additional_announcements.limitations: No later opened source in this bounded review proves universal rollout.

additional_announcements.claim: Full consumer RealAssist availability rolling out after June limited beta.
additional_announcements.limitations: Realtor.com+ release is separate entitlement; not proof of every consumer receiving beta.

additional_announcements.claim: Favorite Lists on Android described as later in 2026.
additional_announcements.limitations: Web/iOS documented shipped; Android completion not verified.

research_limitations: Public first-party documentation review only: no accounts created, app installed, paid report purchased or end-to-end workflow executed.
VERIFIED_CURRENT means publicly documented shipped capability (restricted beta identified), not independent UI behavior, uptime, accuracy or reliable data completeness.
All UNKNOWN cells mean insufficient evidence, never NO. Feature family boundaries/regions/report tiers preserved.
Realtor main July article redirected to Europe block; opened official mediaroom and Realtor.com+ release pages are core authority.
Sinyi plain app/AI URLs intermittently failed; official query-bearing AI page opened successfully. App download claims excluded.
Zillow risk section and Homes month-specific valuations differed between indexed snippets and opened pages; this is explicitly recorded.
General listing comments differ from structured inspection notes; rental template downloads differ from secure case document vaults; shared reports differ from concurrent case editing.
Undated pages use publication_date=null. Date checked is not a release date. No sources after 2026-10-10 cutoff included.
Vendor claimed accuracy/coverage is not independently validated; no geographic transfer or financial completeness inferred.
